title: Vulnerability-amplifying interaction loops: a systematic failure mode in AI chatbot mental-health interactions
reasoning: The paper introduces the SIM-VAIL framework for auditing the clinical safety of AI chatbots in mental health scenarios. While it benchmarks dimensions like sycophancy and stigma, the primary focus is on clinical failure modes and risk trajectories in a mental health context rather than the evaluation of religious beliefs, moral philosophies, or general ethics.
